scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm run infra:up
scripts.infra:wait: until [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' flora-db-1 2>/dev/null)" = healthy ]; do sleep 1; done
scripts.infra:psql: docker exec -it flora-db-1 psql -U flora -d flora
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm run infra:up && pnpm run infra:wait && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.infra:aws:start: aws ec2 start-instances --instance-ids "$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name FloraProd --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='InstanceId'].OutputValue" --output text)" --query "StartingInstances[0].CurrentState.Name" --output text
scripts.infra:aws:stop: aws ec2 stop-instances --instance-ids "$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name FloraProd --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='InstanceId'].OutputValue" --output text)" --query "StoppingInstances[0].CurrentState.Name" --output text
scripts.infra:aws:status: aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids "$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name FloraProd --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='InstanceId'].OutputValue" --output text)" --query "Reservations[0].Instances[0].State.Name" --output text
